observations.notes: Net EUR ex-works material per m; labour person-hours per m. Rebased from the per-m3 reference using a nominal 300 x 600 mm section (0.18 m2) on the reference values of 400.0 EUR and 16.0 h per m3, so the m basis is derived rather than sourced. The Elementplan element prices this product per m.
